CustomField.description: Written by: call 1. Read by: the derivations. The state the words voice, one direction, from the family's runtime-closed set. Never a false, never an inversion, never a two-sided verdict: true-or-nothing, so words either voice the question's own direction or produce no pair at all. Text rather than a picklist because the closed set differs per family and is composed at runtime; the closing is code's job, not the field's.
CustomField.label: Meaning
